changelog:
v3.5.1 — Stability & Device Compatibility Fixes

• Fixed crash on mt8695 Fire TV Sticks (Build.SOC_MODEL API 31+ access)
• Fixed UserPlanManager crash when server returns malformed response
• Fixed ExoPlayer release crash (listener callback race condition)
• HEVC buffer storm recovery on amlogic devices (FFmpeg audio rebuild)
• "Optimizing video playback" message during decoder recovery
• Reduced diagnostic log noise (network capability throttling)
